violations.why: req3_isr (higher priority) can preempt req2_isr between its write and read of irq and overwrite it, so the check at 313 can fail.
req4_isr can preempt req2_isr and overwrite irq before the read at 313.
req5_isr can preempt req2_isr and overwrite irq before the read at 313.
req5_isr has higher priority than req4_isr and can overwrite irq between its write and the check at 336.
req5_isr can preempt req6_isr's JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var1 and change the value, so the two reads can differ.
req4_isr can preempt req6_isr's JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var2 and write it, if the condition2 check passes. That happens if it runs before main sets condition2.
